arguments.message: Completed and validated the shared-drug sponsor network and annual study-start comparison for melanoma studies involving pembrolizumab starting in 2015–2025 inclusive. The selected sponsors are Providence Health & Services; University of California, San Francisco; and Yale University. Ranking used shared-intervention counts with Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC across the complete eligible population; ties were broken by canonical sponsor ID. The network display is clipped, but selection used the complete network. Shared-drug links indicate overlapping interventions, not necessarily collaboration. Annual counts use study start dates.
